turns.question: How much money went back to customers through partner returns in early October 2026?
turns.answer: Partner returns came to 89.75 EUR over 1 to 10 October 2026 (returns_eur, the sum of partner return amounts by return date; I read "early October" as 1 to 10 October). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.
